summary: Least-cost feasible insertion repairs a partial CVRP solution while maintaining capacity.
description: Input is a full distance matrix, demands, capacity, partial routes and an ordered list of distinct unserved customers. Return routes omitting depot markers, or None if existing-only repair fails.

For each pending customer find the minimum marginal-cost position among routes with room. Open a singleton only if no current route can receive that customer and opening is allowed. The single-route insertion callback supports regret insertion and works within one route. Each greedy insertion scans the current routes and their insertion positions once.
